title: Make CanonicalJsonWriter escape all JSON control characters
description: Council serialization review found a reader/writer contract mismatch. MiniJsonReader rejects raw characters below U+0020 inside JSON strings, but CanonicalJsonWriter.Escape previously emitted only named escapes for quote, backslash, newline, carriage return, and tab. Other U+0000..U+001F controls could therefore be serialized as invalid JSON. Escape now emits named JSON escapes for backspace/form-feed and unicode escapes (`\u00xx`) for all remaining control characters. Existing normal-string output remains byte-stable, and the serialized value round-trips through JsonDnaSerializer.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Fixed CanonicalJsonWriter.Escape and added JsonDnaSerializerTests.Serialize_EscapesAllJsonControlCharactersInStringFields. Test covers NUL, SOH, BEL, backspace, form-feed, newline, carriage-return, tab, and U+001F; asserts no raw controls remain and the DisplayName round-trips. No Unity execution was performed in this harness.
